$comment: Talentum website blocks: the ONE place a block's fields, defaults and sample data are defined. The editor (frontend/src/lib/siteBlocks.ts), the server whitelist (pb_hooks/lib/blocktypes.js) and the renderer's tests (talentum-sites npm run test:blocks) all read it. Edit here, then run: node scripts/block-schema/sync.mjs. A field written "@name" is shared_fields.name. extra_keys: data keys the renderer reads that have no editor field (set by starters/importers, or wording with a default). Every block also gets @background + @anchor (unless no_background) and @in_depth + @in_depth_label (unless no_in_depth) in the editor.
